_note: Batch 9, the tail. Twelve cards across eight posts, and FOUR posts deliberately get none: 3116 Skeletal Traction (an inpatient orthopedic procedure, its one candidate was criteria for a bone stimulator, not a reader decision), 3162 Muscle Strain (its seven tips are generic listicle padding, Monitor and Evaluate / Advanced Therapies), 3365 Stress Fracture (every section is prose, nothing enumerable), 3850 Workplace Injuries (its only list is workers-comp admin). The score under-counted here and the read corrected upward: 3894, 3918, 3924 and 3934 each yielded two cards from sections the heuristic had missed, while 3918's own shortlisted candidate, Why Gout Usually Hits at Night, was dropped as causal background. 3792 ships the dos only: the heading promises don'ts but the body has none, and inventing them was not an option. 3894 'When to Call 911 vs Urgent Care' was dropped at the anchor stage: it is an h3 inside the same h2 section as the signs card, so both would have stacked at one heading, and its three items already appear in the common-signs panel.
